question: can a curve over F_2 whose Jacobian carries the ECC2K-130 subgroup be produced, and at what genus?
verdict: No construction reaches the window [130, 290..300]. Best explicit curve carrying A: the modular curve X_H(30503529) mod 2, genus 508799809 (2^28.92); geometrically cyclic degree-131 covers of any curve of genus <= 1 over F_2 need genus >= 1300. Whether A is isogenous to a Jacobian of genus <= ~300 remains open.
